text:
alex.c: Heads-up — we're assembling a partner-facing repo with reference architectures + Terraform modules to streamline cloud marketplace packaging (AWS/Azure/GCP) and SI handoffs. Need a quick onboarding/checklist for the partners.

mira_p: +1. Can we split by cloud and by delivery artifact? e.g., refarch diagrams, deployable sample app, TF modules, marketplace listing artifacts.

jonathan: I'd add a CI gating checklist: lint, tfsec, fmt, module tests, provider pinning, and a release artifact build that creates a marketplace bundle.

samir_r: Also need clear guidance on private deployment options — VPC peering, customer KMS, and how to toggle on-prem bits in the templates. Partners always ask about air-gapped flow.

alex.c: Agreed. Draft checklist idea: 1) repo scaffold + CODEOWNERS 2) refarch diagram (draw.io + export) 3) terraform modules (examples + README) 4) CI (lint/plan/apply dry-run) 5) marketplace package manifest 6) security checklist (KMS, audit logs) 7) SI handoff notes + runbook. Thoughts?

tia-ops: Can we standardize the TF module interface? i.e. input vars: region, instance_profile, network_ids, kv_enabled (bool), marketplace_ami (string) — we should provide a small example: 

```hcl
module "redwood_inference" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-templates.git//modules/redwood_inference"
  region = var.region
  network_ids = var.network_ids
  kv_enabled = true
}
```

mira_p: That sample looks good. We should include OIDC/IRSA patterns for AWS and Managed Identity for Azure in the templates. Also a short script for packaging the marketplace bundle.

partner-bot: CI status: branch "partner/refarch-modules" — build passed, tfsec: 0 high issues, 2 medium (kms_policy), plan step: warnings only.

jonathan: Nice. Action items: alex to create repo skeleton + CODEOWNERS, jonathan will draft CI config and tfsec baseline, tia to write module interface + example, samir to draft private-deploy runbook, mira to own marketplace manifest template. I'll open PRs by EOD.

alex.c: I'll spin up the repo and seed with the refarch PNG + sample app. Link will be posted here. Also adding a partner checklist markdown at /docs/PARTNER_ONBOARDING.md.

samir_r: Quick note on versioning — recommend semantic versioning for modules and keeping a changelog per cloud provider. Partners want predictable upgrades.

mira_p: +1. add an approval step for major version bumps in the CODEOWNERS.

alex.c: OK creating repo now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-templates/tree/partner/refarch-modules 

partner-bot: New repo created: redwood-inference/partner-templates by alex.c. Initial commit: repo scaffold.

tia-ops: I'll add the first module scaffold and a tiny example app that runs a local inference container + NGINX fronting. Keeps partner tests simple.

alex.c: Great. Let's reconvene tomorrow for a short sync (15m) to align the checklist and CI gates. @mira_p @jonathan @samir_r @tia-ops please react with :thumbsup: if you can make it.

mira_p: :thumbsup:

jonathan: :thumbsup:

samir_r: :thumbsup:

tia-ops: :thumbsup:

alex.c: Thanks all — I'll drop the calendar invite.
